title: QA Matrix Record
description: One row = one (scenario x address_category x viewport x browser) check. Append one JSON object per line to a .jsonl results file — never rewrite the file in place.

run_id.description: Groups all checks from one agent-browser run, e.g. 2026-08-24T14-00-agentbrowser-1

scenario.description: Dot-namespaced check id, e.g. eventing.sessionStarted, path.unserviceable-cox, visual.hero, urlparam.pre-loc

address_category.description: Fixed fixture set from the source QA sheet. Null for scenarios that don't vary by address.

status.description: OPEN = incomplete evidence, not a pass or fail. NEEDS_HUMAN = out of scope for scripted assertion (e.g. visual-vs-Figma).

har_path.description: Relative path to the captured HAR/evidence file backing this check, if any.

figma_url.description: Figma node/frame link this row is compared against (visual.* scenarios). See references/visual-figma.md — used to pull design context/screenshot via the Figma MCP for a first-pass diff; a human still confirms before flipping status off NEEDS_HUMAN.

notes.description: Free text — required when status is FAIL, OPEN, or BLOCKED.
